request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change his clothes and skin: the dark flying cap becomes an orange-brown leather flying cap, keeping the goggles; take off the dark tunic so his chest, belly, arms and legs are bare skin; he wears a short orange-brown leather loincloth and one orange-brown leather strap across the chest to the satchel. His skin a deeper, darker true goblin green. Keep the face, ears, the raised bomb with its yellow stripes and spark, the satchel, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style the same.
